components.css: .ds-timeline{padding:13px 16px 20px 0;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg);overflow-x:auto;}.ds-fixture{margin:0 0 13px 11px;color:var(--muted);font:11px/1.5 var(--mono);}.ds-lane{display:grid;grid-template-columns:70px minmax(0,1fr);min-height:55px;}.ds-lane+.ds-lane{margin-top:3px;}.ds-lane-label{display:flex;align-items:center;padding-left:11px;color:var(--muted);font:11px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.025em;}.ds-plot{position:relative;min-height:55px;background-color:#120f0d;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);}.ds-segment{position:absolute;top:11px;left:0;width:70%;height:32px;box-sizing:border-box;overflow:hidden;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:2px;white-space:nowrap;font:550 12px/1.5 var(--sans);}.ds-silence{background:#37312b;color:#cfc6bd;}.ds-segment[data-open="true"],.ds-holding[data-open="true"]{border-right:2px dashed var(--fg);}.ds-holding{position:absolute;top:46px;left:25%;width:45%;height:5px;background:var(--holding);}.ds-empty{position:absolute;left:10px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:var(--muted);font:12px var(--mono);white-space:nowrap;}.ds-timeline:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--fg);outline-offset:4px;}

narrative.overview: A warm near-black operating console with monochrome controls and semantic state color. The large tally, timestamped caller/agent tracks and nearby run controls support a short laptop demonstration; detailed provenance and the event ledger sit below the main interaction.
keyCharacteristics: Large state tally; precise event time.
Flat surfaces, restrained corners and visible borders.
Synthetic and unverified playback status remain explicit.
dos: Do keep state names, timestamps and provenance visible alongside semantic color.
Do preserve native controls, visible focus, keyboard shortcuts and reduced-motion behavior.
Do label every fixture view synthetic, no audio and not evidence.
donts: Don't draw a waveform without real waveform data.
Don't give an unknown interval a known endpoint or duration.
Don't present received backend audio as verified speaker playback.
